description:

Apartment is in back of building and relatively quiet. Fast Wifi. Desk. Shared kitchen. Good fit for internship, relocating, or visit to NYC.

The space
Private room with comfortable queen size memory foam mattress in 8 x 10 space. Has storage & desk with fan & air conditioner during warmer months. Heat pipe runs throughout apartment during colder months. Guests from all over the world have stayed here over the years. You will share the kitchen & bathroom with 2 other people. 3 rooms and 3 people total share the apartment including you.

Best for budget travelers looking for a safe, clean, convenient home base to experience NYC. Again it is in a three bedroom BASEMENT apartment. IMPORTANT NOTE: you must enter through building courtyard to get to apartment - you will pass recycling & garbage stored in the courtyard. description:
Cozy, comfortable, one bedroom apartment on ground floor of detached Victorian home. Quiet, one way street with minimal traffic.

The space
Greenpoint Place still has great dates available but we are booking up fast!
You will enjoy a fully furnished living space which occupies the entire ground floor of our 1889 Victorian home. We offer you a complete kitchen w/ all appliances, beautifully tiled bath w/oversize shower and a separate bedroom w/queen bed, closet and chest of drawers. Living room w/HDTV and a queen size sofa bed for additional sleeping space. Linens, towels, basic paper products and soap/shampoo are included. On street parking is free, safe and widely available most likely in front of our home. We are a short walk to the 7 train which puts you along 42nd St. in one stop! The East River Ferry, a nice alternative to the subway, is only six blocks away on India St. and the East River! Fabulous restaurants, galleries and bars are flooding our neighborhood.
Enjoy the unique, diverse community feeling of Greenpoint. You will feel relaxed and at home after leaving the hustle and bustle of the city. We are as close as you can get to Manhattan without being in it!
Just stay in Greenpoint! You'll be glad you did!

Guest access
The back door in the apartment is an emergency exit only. There is no smoking or congregating out the back door.
If you would like to smoke, you must stand on the sidewalk and dispose of your cigarette butts in a public garbage bin on the corner of Eagle & Manhattan. Thank you!

Other things to note
Please message me with specific questions regarding the layout of the space. This is a part of our home and we respect the privacy of our guests while sharing our warmth and hospitality!

description:
Enjoy peace and quiet and the comforts of home in a vibrant neighborhood with easy access to Manhattan!

You'll have this sunny, quiet, recently renovated third floor suite all to yourself, with kitchen, living room, two bedrooms, and private bathroom. Hosts live on site and are available to help.

We’re in a lively part of Astoria, with plenty of shops, bars, and restaurants to enjoy. After a short walk to the Ditmars N/W stop, the train is 15-20 minutes to Manhattan.

The space
This is a hosted rental with the host present; we live on the lower two floors and your space is on the third floor. Aside from sharing a front door and entryway, the space is completely private.

With two bedrooms, one with a queen and one with a double bed, the space is perfect for families or for friends traveling together. The larger bedroom can be opened to the living room to let in light, or closed off with doors and curtains for complete privacy. It has a wardrobe for storage and a desk for remote work; the second bedroom is cozy with a large closet.

The kitchen is well equipped for cooking including full-sized refrigerator, four-burner gas stove, and dishwasher, and it's stocked with dishes and essentials. Our FiOS internet is very fast for work or entertainment, and the Roku TV provides all the major streaming services (Netflix, Apple TV, Hulu, HBO Max, Disney+). A bluetooth speaker lets you enjoy your own music, and there's a mini-library of quirky NYC guidebooks, histories, and novels to explore.

We have three sons and we'll gladly provide you with any baby equipment that you need (portable crib, high chair, baby tub, toys and books, etc.).

Guest access
NYC prohibits listing full apartments as short-term rentals. Though this property is listed as a room, it is a full guest suite on the top floor of our townhouse. You will not be sharing the spaces described and pictured with anyone else. Our family lives on the lower floors of the house, but apart from sharing the front door and the entryway, the spaces are separate.

During your stay
We live downstairs and are generally available for any questions about the apartment or the neighborhood. We try to be available for your check-in, but a lockbox is available if that doesn't work out.

Other things to note
Access to the apartment is up two flights of stairs, so it's not a good place for anyone with mobility challenges.

We try to space bookings out by a day or more, so we can almost always accommodate early check-in and/or late check-out; just let us know your schedule!

NYC now restricts short-term stays to no more than two guests in a single property; if you need lodging for more, please get in touch. We may be able to arrange a space nearby for additional people.

The kitchen area is directly over our bedroom, so we do ask that you keep activity there to a minimum late at night. Noise from living room and bedrooms is not an issue.

We do not access phones/internet from sundown Friday to sundown Saturday except for emergencies; if you contact us via Airbnb during that time, we'll respond Saturday night or Sunday morning.

description:
The Private Comfy Bedroom comes with a semi-private bathroom. I say Semi-private because it's shared with the host. The room may be configured with a desk or an arm chair but not both. Let me know if you have a preference. The room can get loud from the street noise on the weekends, but not always, and i do provide earplugs if you need them. The room is nicely decorated. The room is ni the fromt of the house and gets a generous amount of sunlight thruogh the oversived brownstone window.

The space
You will love this private comfy bedroom in this 2 bedroom duplex apt. in a Central Harlem Brownstone apt.
One of the best and most trendy neighboorhood in NYC. You will love this semi-private bedroom shared only with the hoste, sometimes. The room has a large closet, 5 d3awer chest, TV, Night stands and lamps and yes a full size bed. You will have access to a commercial type working kitchen (eat-In).

This fabulously located two bedroom duplex apartment on the garden and parlor floors of a classic brownstone is clean, quiet and comfortable. You will have the south facing bedroom. This room is perfectly located and set-up for tourists and those visiting for study or business.
You’re only minutes away from Times Square via the subway at 125th St., and after a day enjoying the attractions of New York City, you’ll love coming back to relax in the sunny living area, catch up with friends at home via the free wi-fi connection, watch some television, or take a quick nap on the comfortable full sized bed before heading out to some of the funky bars and music venues of Central Harlem.
If a quiet night is more your style and you like cooking for yourself, there are great food stores close by for supplies, and a well-equipped kitchen to transform your ingredients.
For those guests able to stay longer there is plenty of storage space in the room.

What you need to know:
• full sized bed

• comfortable furniture in the common living room
• TV, free wi-fi
• fully equipped kitchen

• check-in after 3.00pm, check out at 12.00 noon
• check in and out may be flexible depending on bookings

Location -Central Harlem has been described as the heart and soul of Harlem - a mixture of the past and the present. You’ll find the Apollo Theatre here and other historic buildings, many transformed into contemporary music venues. Marcus Garvey Park is about 10 minutes walk away and Central Park just a few blocks further south.
It’s a safe, friendly and fun neighborhood, with lots of great restaurants and bars nearby – a taste of real New York. The apartment is in a quiet street between Malcolm X Boulevard and Seventh Ave.

This is the real New York City experience: Spanish Harlem all inclusive and a rich blend of cultures all living together and enjoying each others company!! This apartment has hardwood floors, full kitchen, private bathroom and a balcony facing everyone's backyard. We are centrally located and between Lexington & Park Avenue. The space
This is a Studio apartment it has all the amenities you'll need. It is 400 sq ft and it has a kitchen with a full size refrigerator, stove with an oven and a kitchen counter to eat or work on, a bathroom with a full size bathtub and you have your own seperate entrance. Located in trendy East Spa Ha district, we are located just two blocks from the start of the one mile museum walk and Beautiful Central Park. Spa Ha is known for it's multicultural popular cafe's, bars, restaurant's and The Apollo Theater. In June we have The East Harlem International Film Festival which is very exciting and fresh. Also, we have Madison Avenue and all it's splendor! Famous fashion boutiques, salons and painting galleries.
One block away there is a private indoor parking for your car and a laundromat across the street. Mount Sinai Hospital just a half mile from us in case your sick and don't feel well. All the necessities are all around us.
This Victorian Brownstone has been recently remodeled yet retaining many charming details such as exposed bricks, crown moldings, breakfast counter bar and wood floors. The apartments come completely furnished and include cable and internet and wifi.

Other things to note
The shopping mall is just about 10 blocks from us and Marshall's is a great place to shop for labeled clothes at a fraction of the cost, and you have Costco to get your monthly supply of items you need.

listing_name: Bright+Spacious Williamsburg Abode!
description:
This bright one bedroom apartment is located in the lovely Southside of WIlliamsburg, Brooklyn. There is plenty of sunshine and space for 1-2 people to sleep, work, cook, eat and do whatever else your heart desires in this great city!

The space
There is one queen bed that comfortably accommodates up to two people or a couple. The bathroom has a shower with a very large old fashioned soaking tub. And the kitchen has all of the supplies and cookware needed for a night in if you should decide to.
It is also nice to spend the mornings relaxing, reading or sipping tea or coffee in the light flooded living room thanks to being located on the 5th floor, also giving great views.
Not pictured is a beautiful vintage desk in the living room where you can comfortably work from home.

In the summer there is a wonderful cross breeze when the windows are open, and there is a strong AC unit for when the temperatures get high. In the winter the heat is automatically on plus there is an additional radiator for very chilly nights. You will be comfortable and cozy no matter what the season.

*Please get in touch before reserving the apartment to let me know how long you want to stay and a little bit about yourself/your trip to NYC. Thanks!

Other things to note
Just steps away from amazing local restaurants, bars, and shops, there is so much to do right in the neighborhood. However if you do decide to venture into Manhattan, the trains are a short few blocks walk making the big city only minutes away.
Laundromat, dry cleaning, pharmacy, delis, hardware, wine + liquor and grocery stores are also close by just in case!
Please check out the guidebook which I try to regularly update with my favorite local spots!

listing_name: Cozy Garden Apartment  in Williamsburg
description:
Come stay in the best location in Williamsburg! You will be just a few blocks away from restaurants, movie theaters, bars, gift shops, book stores as well as high end chain stores. There are plenty of Gyms, Pilates and Yoga studios. Domino Park on the waterfront that has spectacular views of Manhattan is two blocks away.

Enjoy all the comforts of home while you explore one of the hippest neighborhoods in Brooklyn, if not in the world.

The space
The small apartment is on the lower level of our town house and is completely private with it's own entrance. There is a queen sized bed in the bedroom and and an American Leather full sleeper sofa in the living room.

There is a small kitchenette that has what you need to prepare meals with pots, pans, dishes, silverware, toaster, stove, oven, and a refrigerator. For your coffee needs we have a coffee maker, percolator and French press.

A laundry mat is a few blocks away so visitors can take care of their personal laundry. There is also an iron with a mini ironing board and we can loan you our vacuum cleaner .

This is urban living with low ceilings so you will hear foot steps, furniture moving about and the occasional bark from our pup above.

Guest access
Everything you need from shopping to entertainment to transportation are all in walking distance to the apartment. There is street parking but cars have to be moved daily for street cleaning.

Other things to note
There are two sets of steps to access the apartment. One set of two the other set of three both have handrails.

listing_name: Charming Artist's Flat, East Village
description:
The space
If it's an authentic New York experience you're looking for, you've found it. Located in the heart of the East Village of Manhattan, this one bedroom apartment is as cool as the city and as cozy as the country. Perfect for couples or singles. Not suitable for families. East & west facing windows wash the flat in lots of morning and afternoon light, flat screen tv, internet, queen size tempurpedic bed (with memory foam mattress!), laundry/dry cleaners on ground floor, kitchen, full bath.
I collect early American antiques which impart a country charm to this small yet beautiful city apartment.

10-15 minute walk to the F train; 15-20 minutes to N/R & 6 lines. Beautiful historic Tompkins Square Park is just blocks away and anchors the colorful diversity of the neighborhood. The East Village abounds with a bar and cafe culture unmatched in other parts of Manhattan. If you were to throw a stone from my roof the arch of it's trajectory would pass no less than several upscale restaurants and downscale dive bars. The only neighborhood in New York!

Everything you will need is provided. Towels, linens, toiletries, umbrellas if it rains, books (but why read when there's so much to do?) etc. All you have to do is show up.

Note:
Apartment is on the 5th floor of an old tenement building. No elevator. The stairs are no joke. If you bring lots of luggage you're in for a challenge. You wanted an authentic New York experience right? You'll have the best legs south of 14th St. when you leave!

The building is heated in winter by steam heat. The pipes can rattle when hot water is flowing thru them. Common in Lower East Side tenements.

Weekends can be noisy. That's what happens when you're surrounded by amazing bars and fantastic restaurants.

description:

** I'm also Fully Vaccinated. I had my Pfizer double-shot. My 2nd dose was April 1st, 2021. I've also been triple-boosted**

The space
@!@ IF YOU'RE COMING FOR THE FIFA World Cup 2026 please scroll down to the bottom of my description for more info @!@

Your Fully Private Room has one comfortable queen size loft bed 🛌 with a Tuft & Needle mattress. It also includes:

* 46” Samsung HD Smart 3D LED TV 📺 (with Netflix, Amazon Prime Video & YouTube Premium)
* Samsung 3D Smart Blu-ray Disc Player (with 3D glasses!)
* WiFi (200 Mbps)
* Mini-Fridge
* Air Conditioning / Heat
* Freshly cleaned sheets, pillows, blankets, bath towels & washcloths
* NYC Guidebooks, Maps and a Native New Yorker's knowledge of cool local 'off-the-beaten-path' stuff to do
* Rotating DISCO 🪩 💃🏽 🕺🏿 BALL & Light!
* 2 Arcade1Up PartyCades with 18 games!!

Most of my visitors are couples, family or good friends who don't mind sharing the bed together. However, I do have a comfortable Intex twin-size air mattress available (BY ADVANCE REQUEST ONLY), but it does make the space in the room a bit tight.

The room is clean, quiet and dark at night. I say this because living in NYC that's often difficult to find with all the street noise, noisy neighbors and bright lights blaring in one's windows. Not the case at my place. You'll sleep 💤 very well.

I have two retro Arcade1Up PartyCades. They’re available for guests to play anytime for free. Some games can even be played together in two-player mode with my additional game controller 🎮 like Joust, Rampage and Street Fighter! 👊

Games included are Defender, Gauntlet, Klax, Rootbeer Tapper, Bubbles, Joust, Rampage, Wizard of War, Sinistar, Gorf, Street Fighter II: The World Warrior, Super Street Fighter II Turbo, Street Fighter II: Champion Edition, Super Puzzle Fighter II: Turbo, Strider, Captain Commando, Eco Fighters and Ghosts ‘n Goblins.

Although I have a fully stocked kitchen I prefer that my guests don’t use it to cook. You’re on vacation after all, visiting NYC, which is a gastronomical and cultural smörgåsbord. You have a mini-fridge in your room.

For a small fee I rent my bicycles 🚴(all 6 of them). Cheaper than renting at any bike shop, you can ride them all day/night too. I also lead easy, safe and fun Night Bicycling Tours of Central Park with Nightrider NYC, as well as other short tours by bike, foot and/or subway. I bicycle toured/camped across the USA twice and rode across Europe in '87, before cell phones and the internet made us all lazy. Let me know what your interests are and maybe I can put something together for you.

I LOVE ❤️ hosting & meeting new people & if I have the time I'll show you around my neighborhood - just ask. I've had some really fun experiences with my former guests.

You'll have some closet space w/hangars & a drawer in my dresser for your clothing, as well as a empty drawer in the WC for your toiletries 🧻 . I have many shampoos, conditioners & other assorted toiletries which you are welcome to use as well as laundry detergent (there's a Laundromat right next to my building).

I'm on the top 5th floor of a 5-story brownstone walk-up **THERE IS NO ELEVATOR**

I provide clean sheets, blankets, pillows & towels and have other assorted toiletries that you can use, including an iron & hairdryer. My place is clean - no bedbugs here!

**I'M A NON-SMOKER 🚭 & DON'T ALLOW SMOKING IN MY APARTMENT OR ANYWHERE ELSE IN THE BUILDING**

My check-in time is flexible, starting at noon, going until whenever you need to arrive. On a case-by-case basis I might be able to allow an earlier check-in time. Check-out is noon, but, again, on a case-by-case basis I might be able to allow a later check-out time.

I'm a big BROADWAY 🎭 buff. I see nearly every show that comes to NY. This could be a Very Expensive 💴 Hobby, but as I'm a New Yorker who comes from a theater background I have connections and can 'sometimes' get tickets MUCH CHEAPER than anywhere else. If you wanna see a show during your visit (and I wholeheartedly recommend you do so), let me know and I'll try and work my magic for you!

I’m also a member of these 3 following ticket sites that I pay a yearly membership fee to in order to get cheap tickets from: Play-by-Play, Clubfreetime and TDF . During your stay I’ll logon to show you the current offerings and get you ticks to something if you want. Also check out the sites BroadwayForBrokePeople and BwayRush to find out about the cheap Rush and Lottery policies for each Broadway 🎭 show.

If you're a museum junkie, visiting all the cultural institutions that NYC has to offer can be rather expensive 💰. Many places have a ‘suggested donation’ admission, but it’s only for New Yorkers. Don’t worry — I’ve got your back. I’ll give you my extra ID and you can use it to get the special deal. When I visit the MET or the Museum of Natural History (among others) I just pay $1 to get in. Check out this for more info: NYCforfree .

I'm not a gym rat, but I do workout at the local gym (Manhattan Plaza Heath Club - MPHC) that's a 10 minute walk from my bldg. If I bring you with me I can get you a $25 day pass. There's a pool, hot tub, full gym and even a rock-climbing center you can use for the day, plus you can take any of the free classes they offer).

As for me, I'll be sleeping in the living room on the Murphy Wall Bed (see my photos for more into)

Got stinky undies? Well, wash 'em then! I have detergent & fabric softener you can use. A cheap & reliable Coin-Operated Laundromat is right next to my building. You can do it yourself or just drop it off to have it washed (usually done the same day/pay by the pound - or kilo for you crazy Europeans.)

Thanks for checking my place out. If you have any questions let me know!

** I'm also Fully Vaccinated 😷 for Covid through Pfizer. I've been triple-boosted **

*** IF AVAILABLE, for an extra $50 per night for a booking of 2 people you can have my Full Private Apartment. If the booking is for 1 person it's an additional $65 per night ***

@!@ njtworldcup
metlifestadium

Unfortunately Airbnb won't allow me to post links here but I can tell you how to get to MetLife Stadium from NYC Penn Station. It's easy. Penn Station is on 8th Avenue and West 34th Street. I live on 10th Avenue between West 46th & 48th Streets.

In short, you'll have to download an App on your phone to purchase your train tickets. They go on sale on May 13th. Ask me any questions you might have about this and I'll explain it in greater detail. @!@

Guest access
NOTHING is off-limits at my flat -- My place is Your Place! You can use my kitchen, just not at 3am! (you know, during Reasonable hours). You're welcome to use and relax in my front room, unless I'm there working or sleeping.

During your stay
During your stay you can be as private as you want, or come and socialize a bit with me. I like to show my guests around my neighborhood and, if they like, go out for a drink or two. I'm also an avid cyclist, and could possibly take you on a tour of Central Park (I have 6 bikes in the basement we can use). I'll be sleeping in the front room most nights and in-and-out during the day. If you want some ideas & suggestions on off-the-beaten-track stuff that us NYC locals do, just ask!!

Although Hell's Kitchen has a pretty sordid history, it's now one of the hippest neighborhoods in Madhattan! Full of great bars and diverse restaurants that stay open late, just a 15 minute walk to the Theatre District and Times Square, it's a safe, centrally located area where you'll find a lot to do and see for the entire family.

I'm a Handyman/Writer/Actor/Bicycle Tour Guide and Amateur USBC Bowler trying to survive in the Concrete Jungle we call the Big Apple. I've been surviving here since 1984, so I must be doing something right!

Formerly a rare bookshop, the garden suite resounds with Harlem Heights' history from the Founding Fathers thru the Founding Brothers to our vibrant now. At the time Duke Ellington dubbed the house “The Crown of Sugar Hill,” the immediate neighborhood was also home to Joe Louis, W.E.B. The full kitchen features coffee/tea facilities and welcome food supplies (fresh gourmet coffee, fresh fruit).

Rooms are furnished in a comfortable, eclectic mix with bookish comforts. There's abundant seating, two desks, two round tables, cable television, a record player, a Harlem-centric record collection, a large library on local history African & American, internet access, and a full ornamental garden with a gas grill. Wine and dine al fresco on Sunday afternoons as the sounds of Marjorie Elliot’s Parlor Jazz waft from her near by apartment.

There is housekeeping service and owners on the premises to assist you in any want or need. This is perhaps the privatest and quietest guest suite in New York City and wholly fills the most exacting legals criteria.



Enjoy local museums, entertainments and Sugar Hill cuisine, old New York charms, and easy transportation (subways and buses within two blocks, car services readily available.)

On premises: library conference rooms, parlor and garden party rentals, computer, internet service, laundry service, cable television, record & Bluetooth players.

description:

Quiet, spacious, tasteful, uniquely furnished 2-story apt w museum-quality art, high ceilings, private elevator.

NYC bans stays <30 days. For shorter stays, find me on the work social platform, and I will share how to legally accommodate this and Airbnb's policies. - Lisa Lefebvre/Lucid Growth Lab

The space
This 1800 sq ft / 170 sq meter apartment is situated in a historic, converted warehouse and has very high (20 ft/ 6 m) ceilings, large windows to the North and South, and a generous skylight, all of which make the apartment sunny -- a rarity in Manhattan.

The space has a rotating art collection. Some paintings and photographs were made by friends, some by artists who had retrospectives at MoMA, and others from contemporary art galleries in South Africa where I used to travel for work.

TO REQUEST A BOOKING
Because this is my home, please tell me a bit about who will be staying. Given that this is an upscale, small, quiet building, the loft is best suited for mature, respectful adults. Note that quiet hours are 8 am - 11 pm, and no parties are allowed.

LOCATION
If you are browsing this listing, you already know SoHo is the most stimulating, creative, and centrally located NYC neighborhood to live in, work in, and visit. Many celebrities live in this area. Even if you don't book this particular loft, I highly recommend visitors stay in SoHo.

SoHo is at the center of the most interesting neighborhoods in NYC, almost all of which are within walking distance: NoLiTa, Greenwich Village, Union Square, Flatiron, Chinatown, East Village/Lower East Side, and TriBeCa.

DOWNSTAIRS LAYOUT
On the first floor, the keyed elevator opens up into a large living and dining area. A full bath is off to the left. It is small, but clean and functional, with a shower and shelving for toiletries.

The kitchen is fully stocked with tools and pantry items which you are welcome to use if needed. There is a pharmaceutical-grade water filter under the kitchen sink.

In the back of the first floor is a cozy living room situated under the large skylight -- this is the room most favored by my friends.

UPSTAIRS LAYOUT
The second floor has an additional sitting area with a television. If needed, the couch can be converted into a comfortable single bed to sleep 5 in total. *Please let me know if you would like this option before your arrival.*

The upstairs bathroom includes double sinks, a sauna, a jacuzzi tub, and a shower stall. There is a pharmaceutical-grade water filter on the upstairs shower head. This means the water pressure is a little lower than normal, but all toxins will have been filtered out.

There is also a full washer/dryer, iron, and ironing board.

SLEEPING AREAS
There are two sleeping areas upstairs. Mattresses are exceptionally comfortable with memory foam toppers. All linens are hotel-quality, and used only for guests.

The front sleeping area is an alcove with a Double bed. This room is situated under the skylight. Because this is a loft, it does not have a door but there is an opaque curtain that can be drawn shut for privacy. (It is wonderful to sleep here during a rain or snow storm!)

The back sleeping area has a Queen bed and a wall of windows. It is very quiet. The back bedroom windows can include blackout curtains. *Please mention you would like this option when booking.*

Please note this is a true loft so there are no bedroom doors, but both sleeping areas are very private from each other. The floor plan in the photo gallery section can help you understand the layout of the bedrooms vis-à-vis each other.

While there are no closets per se, there is a garment rack with ample hangers for hanging clothes, suitcase racks, and a wardrobe in the front/library bedroom.

A CHALLENGE TO SOME, AN ADVANTAGE TO OTHERS ...
The loft has many artful, delicate objects and furnishings. A few guests have commented that this is stressful for families with small children. If you would like me to remove fragile objects for your stay, please let me know as I would be glad to do this.

TRANSPORTATION
SoHo is the only neighborhood in NYC where all 5 major Manhattan subways have stops, so it is an extremely convenient and fast area from which to get around Manhattan or to Brooklyn.

INSIDER EXPERIENCES
Please see the Airbnb app for a neighborhood guide with insider tips on what to do in the neighborhood and beyond. Someone could literally spend a month in the 20 square blocks surrounding the apartment and still not fully experience all the interesting options in the area.

I look forward to the possibility of being your host and helping you enjoy this wonderful neighborhood!

CHECK IN/CHECK OUT TIMES
Check-in time is 4:00 PM, and check-out time is 11 AM.

ADDITIONAL CLEANING
I have a wonderful housekeeper who can help with weekly bedding/towel laundry and cleaning for a pass-through cost of $200. *Please let me know when booking if you would like this service*.

IN SUM
I look forward to the possibility of hosting you and helping enjoy NYC like a true New Yorker.

Guest access
The entire loft.

While we adhere to NYC laws, which mandate that the space be shared, we make sure that our guests feel that their privacy is fully respected at all times and have designed the space accordingly.

This grand, spacious floor-through is in a classic 1890s brownstone house in the historic Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood of Brooklyn. Located on a quiet, tree-lined street, 25/30 minutes from and to Downtown Manhattan by subway, door to door. Walk to bars, restaurants & galleries in Bushwick & Stuyvesant Heights. A short subway ride to Williamsburg, and 1 block from a supermarket, liquor store & laundromat.

Neighborhood:
Originally built for the Victorian upper-middle class in the 1800s, predominantly Dutch & other European immigrants. In the 1930s, the neighborhood changed socially & economically, like many other areas in New York City. Until the late 1980's it was mostly African American, during which it developed its own cultural history. Many famous jazz musicians, actors, rappers & politicians came from here. Now in the 2010s, it is an incredible mix of races with varied socio-economic backgrounds. Many of the old-time residents still live here. More recently, there has been an influx of more diverse younger residents, attracted to the neighborhood for the beautiful architecture and the convenience of Manhattan.

Transportation:
Subways are the J, Z and M trains to Myrtle Avenue/Broadway station, or J and Z to Kosciuszko Street station. Both stations are parallel to the house and are about a 7 to 10-minute walk at a moderate pace. (7 short blocks to Myrtle, or 2 city blocks to Kosciuszko, same distance). About 25 minutes door to-door to Lower Manhattan. Also accessible to the G train, to Bedford/Nostrand station (5 city blocks, about a 15-minute walk). Very reliable and steady buses as well (B15, B38 & B52) for travel inside Brooklyn. You can do a search engine on New York's MTA transportation system so that you get a sense of how connected the space is. The best airports for the location of the house are JFK and La Guardia. Even though it is reachable, Newark International Airport is discouraged due to the distance and/or complicated public transportation connections. About a $35.00 cab/car ride from JFK / La Guardia airports. There is Public transportation (subway) from JFK Airport to the neighborhood's subway stations. La Guardia is reachable by car/taxi only.

Accommodations:
This is a private space. The main room has a dining table & a living room/sitting area. The bedroom features a 'queen' size' bed for two, it is a real bed with a box spring and mattress. The bedroom also has a vanity table with a mirror and a bookcase with a desk. There are two closets & a chest of drawers in the bathroom hallway. The bathroom has a tub with a shower, tile walls, and a ceramic floor. The original architectural details, high ceilings, and hardwood floors give it a real 'Brooklyn brownstone' feel & charm. The space is heated during the winter with central heating, and there is an air conditioner installed in the bedroom during the summer.

The space has Wi-Fi, and multiple power outlets for computers, cell phones & personal electronics. There is a TV connected to a casting router that allows access to YouTube and Netflix. A DVD player in the apartment. The TV can be connected to some laptops and used as a monitor if yours has an HDMI port. Or you could also get an HDMI-compatible connecting cable to your computer. No cable TV or TV reception though.

listing_name: Elegant Stuyvesant Heights Retreat
description:
Refurnished in 2024. This parlor floor apartment in a historic Brooklyn brownstone provides a sunny breakfast space in which to begin the day, and affords relaxed dining and wind-down at the end of the day in an environment that is elegant, spacious, and warm. Bedrooms are away from the street and very quiet. Excellent restaurants can be found close-by for those who wish to eat out. The neighborhood is calm and retains a deep-rooted and welcoming community.

The space
* English-language description is followed by write-up in French & Spanish

* Una descripción en español sigue las otras

NOTE: We took some time in 2024 to replace certain furniture, rugs, lighting, and appliances so as to keep the place sharp. We also had the brownstone façade replaced -- and the result is gorgeous!

THE LODGING
Gorgeous two-bedroom parlor floor apartment with 10-ft ceilings in a renovated and restored 1800’s brownstone on a quiet block of historic Stuyvesant Heights. The apartment is very private and occupies the entire parlor floor of the house. It offers a grand living room with original carved wooden window trimming and the original parquet floor beautifully preserved; a complete kitchen with plenty of cabinet space; and two bedrooms equipped collectively with three full-sized beds – an individual bed in one room, and a bunkbed in the other. The bathroom is equipped with a tub and shower and generous cabinet space. Closet space is ample, augmented with plentiful overhead suitcase storage space. The place is fully furnished with tables, comfortable seating, and good lighting. Kitchen is stocked with coffee maker, toaster oven, microwave, vegetable chopper, full refrigerator and freezer, coffee, sugar, salt, spices, and basic cooking and serving essentials. Free wireless internet connection available. Small multi-lingual library provided. Tall living room windows face south, flooding the space with sunlight in the winter. Shades on the windows can be drawn for privacy, and to help keep the space cool in the summer (which is easy, given the high ceilings and the cross-draft).

OCCUPANCY
Four-person maximum.
Children twelve years or older welcome.
No pets.

PROVISIONS
clean bed linens, pillows, blankets, and towels
gas stove with oven
coffee maker, toaster oven, microwave, vegetable chopper, teapot with wire filtration basket
coffee, tea, sugar, salt, spices, etc
iron and ironing board
hair dryer on request
free wireless internet
guide to local restaurants, shops, and services (including my recommendations and those of previous guests)
subway map and Brooklyn map

CLEAN AIR POLICY
No smoking in the apartment or anywhere in the building or yard -- including electronic cigarettes. No incense.

THE HOST
On hand or easily reachable and ready to assist in case anything is needed.

THE NEIGHBORHOOD
Stuyvesant Heights is the elegant historic district of Bedford-Stuyvesant, a neighborhood that has produced a host of well-known jazz musicians, rappers, poets, and other artists – but where you might also hear a clarinetist practicing late Brahms chamber music. The population today mixes multi-generation families deeply rooted in the old community network with an influx of younger folk newly discovering the charms of the lovely tree-lined streets, the beautiful architecture, and the dignified manners of neighbors who gracefully welcome new arrivals. A neighborhood tour is staged each fall to show off the lavish elegance and artistry preserved in many of the grand old houses.

SERVICES
Restaurants abound, including the popular Saraghina (one minute walk from the house), which is a classy, atmospheric, yet well priced venue for pizza and other Italian cuisine, drawing people from all over the city; Celestino, specializing in Mediterranean seafood dishes; Peaches, a lively place much frequented by a loyal local crowd and serving up regional American classics; Peaches Hothouse, reputed for its hot pepper chicken; and Besos, featuring Latino-inspired dishes. Within a two-minute walk, you can also find a wine bar, a health-food store, a twenty-four hour deli with fresh produce and organic eggs and sandwich essentials, a drop-off/pick-up laundromat, and the local branch of the New York Public Library. For those looking for gospel music, there is no reason to run all the way to Harlem: a three-minute walk from our doorstep will bring you to a beautiful old church that will welcome you warmly and offer plenty of good singing. Another church lightly chimes the hour in the background, helping you keep track of the rhythm of the day.

FRESH DAILY BREAD
We are pleased to announce the arrival of a bakery, one minute from our doorstep, offering fresh baguettes and other loaves daily, baked on the premises.

THE TRAINS
Eight-minute walk (depending on your stride) down elegant Stuyvesant Avenue (an increasingly frequent location for big film shoots) to a station where both the A-express and C-local trains are available. Trains provide easy access to Manhattan (10-15 minutes to lower Manhattan once on the train, half an hour to Penn Station; 40 minutes to Central Park); and, more locally, to Brooklyn Heights, Prospect Park, the Brooklyn Botanic Garden, and the Brooklyn Museum. In the other direction, you can get to the Air Train to JFK Airport, about a half-hour from our station. Add another fifteen minutes to arrive at the beaches at Far Rockaway.

On the local C-train, it will be just ten minutes to Fort Greene, home of the Brooklyn Academy of Music (excellent venue for film, dance, theater, and concerts), Mark Morris Dance Studios, and myriad diverse restaurants, bars, and late-night spots.

LANGUAGES FOR CORRESPONDENCE
E-mails are accepted in English, French, and Spanish.

ADDITIONAL POSITIVE POINTS
In addition to what is described above, we offer:
Thick firm mattresses – no back-ache in the morning -- full-size: 54 inches wide
calm neighbors: no one will bombard you with excessive noise or drama; the people above you do not wear shoes inside
excellent privacy: main entrance serves only two apartments; no one passes your door; the magnolia tree in the front yard shields the living room from the street with its curtain of leaves
quick assistance: either myself or my housemate is easily accessible in case any questions or issues arise
cleanliness: no rodents have signed leases here, and they generally seem to respect the law

==============================

EN FRANÇAIS

UN APPARTEMENT À DEUX PERSONNES TRANQUILLE ET ENSOLEILLÉ DANS LE QUARTIER HISTORIQUE DE BEDFORD-STUYVESANT

L’appartement se situe dans l’étage le plus elegant d’une maison traditionelle de Brooklyn, un “brownstone” comme on dit, construite dans le 19ème siècle. Vu son âge, j’ai fait une rénovation de toute la maison en 2005, en préservant ce qui restait des détails historiques, et, peut–être plus important, en améliorant les systèmes d’électricité et de plombier. L’appartement qu’on offre aux voyageurs est bien reculé et consiste d’une grande salle de séjour à haut plafond dont les fenêtres donnent sur le rideau de feuilles d’un arbre qui cache l’appartement de la rue; une cuisine bien équipée où on peut facilement preparer un diner pour quatre personnes; une salle de bain simple et propre avec une douche et une baignoire; et deux chambres à dormir où se dressent trois lits très confortables.

L’escalier qui mène à cet espace sert à deux appartements – celui réservé aux voyageurs et l’autre en bas où vivent deux locataires très gentilles et calmes. Donc la maison est douée d’une tranquilité confortable et on peut facilement mener ici une vie privée. Dans le but de préserver cette tranquilité pour nous tous, qui travaillent selon des horaires individuels et diverses, je demande aux voyageurs de se comporter d’une manière calme et respectueuse pour que personne ne risque de perdre le sommeil qui est tellement précieux à New York. Si vous voudriez rencontrer des amis, je vous demande de les rencontrer dans un café ou un restaurant (il y en a assez dans ce quartier où on peut tarder comme on veuille). Même plus important, pour le bonheur et la santé de toute la populace de la maison, et aussi pour le bonheur des voyageurs qui nous visiteront après vous, je vous exige absolument de ne pas fumer dans aucune chambre de l’appartement, même par les fenêtres ouvertes, même dans le jardin près de l’entrée. Dit ça, si vous imaginez que vous trouverez également l’appartement et les conditions de vivre ici bien agréables, c’est sûr que vous vous trouverez très confortable et bienvenu chez nous.

Le quartier lui-même est tranquille et présente une jolie architecture. Beaucoup de musiciens de jazz et de rap, et d’autres artistes, ont commencé leur carrière ici. Aujourd’hui la populace est un mélange composé de familles qui habitent ici depuis de générations et les jeunes qui arrivent actuellement, attirés par la beauté des maisons et des rues avec ses arbres et fleurs bien soignées, et attirés aussi par les bonnes manières et le bienvenu offerts par la vieille communauté. On trouve très près de la maison une agréable variété de restaurants, de cafés, et de magasins pour acheter la nourriture. Pour ceux qui cherchent écouter de la musique “gospel,” vous pouvez l’encontrer ici, trois minutes à pied dès notre maison. Si vous voudriez aller à Manhattan, les trains vous y ammeneront dans une demi-heure.

Si vous avez des questions sur l’appartement ou le quartier, tout le plaisir est à nous de vous donner des réponses les plus utiles que soit possible.

Merci beaucoup pour l’interêt porté sur notre appartement; bonne route; et à bientôt!

EN ESPAÑOL

UN REFUGIO SOLEADO DONDE SE PUEDE RELAJAR O DORMIR TRANQUILAMENTE EN LA CIUDAD QUE NO DUERME NUNCA

IMPORTANTE
Algunos de los habitantes que viven en este edificio son muy sensibles al humo. Pues se prohibe de fumar en el piso y en toda parte de la casa. Gracias por ayudarnos en el objetivo de bien cuidar de todos que se encuentran debajo nuestro techo. (Para que sepa usted, nadie va a gritarle si quema el tostado...)

EL APARTAMENTO
El apartamento que alquilamos se encuentra en el segundo piso de una casa del siglo 19 que renové completamente en 2005. Hay dos cuartos que contienen tres camas; una sala brillante con dos ventanas grandes que dan al sur. Esta es dividida en dos espacios: uno equipado de una mesa para cenar y el otro que contiene dos sillones comodos y un canapé; una cocina complete donde se pueden encontrar el café, el té, el azucar, y varias especias; y un baño sencillo y limpio. Uno de los cuartos es equipado de un escritorio elegante donde se puede leer o escribir a la intimidad. Este piso es muy tranquilo: aunque esté usted en New York, muy cercano a Manhattan, podra dormir aquí placidamente.

NUMERO MAXIMO DE HABITANTES
Cuatro personas. Por favor, no animales.

APROVISIONAMIENTOS
Sábanas, mantas, y toallas limpias
Hornillo con cuatro quemadores, tostadora, cafetera, micro-onda
Café, té, azucar, sal, especias...
Wifi internet gratis
Guía de restaurantes y tiendas
Mapa de trenes & de Brooklyn

EL DUEÑO DE LA CASA
Vivo y de veces trabajo en el piso por encima del cual alquilamos. Pues no es difícil encontrarme si hay preguntas. Si falta alguna cosa, hay que decírmelo, y estaré contento a ayudar. Note que evitamos de llevar zapatos en nuestro apartamento, pues no va usted a soñar con elefantes que bailan toda la noche.

EL BARRIO
Stuyvesant Heights es un barrio histórico y residencial, mostrando la arquitectura característica y elegante de las casas de Brooklyn del decimonoveno siglo – los “brownstones”, como se llaman. Nacieron y trabajaban aquí muchos músicos de jazz y rap, y otros artistas y escritores. Hoy día la población es una mezcla entre las familias establecidas aquí por generaciones y los jóvenes de otros barrios, ciudades, y países que han recientemente descubierto la belleza, la tranquilidad, y los arboles viejos y magníficos del barrio. Se puede encontrar muy cerca de la casa una diversidad de restaurantes – ofriendo la comida italiana, mediterranea, americana latina, etc – y almacenes que pueden proveer frutas, carnes, quesos, sabones y otras necesidades. También hay lavanderías no muy lejos.

LOS TRENES
Estamos cerca del tren que viene del aeropuerto JFK y que continúa para Manhattan. Es posible salir de la casa y llegar por tren a Mahattan en unos treinta minutos.

¿PREGUNTAS?
Si usted tiene cualquier pregunta, le pedimos que nos contacte. Gracias por su interés.

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire apartment, which is all for their private use.

Other things to note
This is a very quiet house at night. In the bedrooms, you might even forget that you are in a big city. One advantage you will find here in terms of getting a good night’s sleep is that each bedroom has an insulated dropped ceiling, so that the light, respectful footsteps that we may make over your heads in the evening will be of little consequence. Then, at midnight plus or minus, we retreat to an upper floor, so that you will have no one directly overhead for most of the night. That makes for a very peaceful space.

listing_name: Clean, Cool ,Cozy Bushwick room
description:
Bright, spacious, and clean private room, perfect for a short stop or a longer stay in one of Brooklyn’s hottest neighborhoods. The location could not be better; with the L-train half a block from the Montrose Ave. stop, taking you to union sq. in 15min (counting the time to get to the station), CitiBikes on the corner, amazing supermarket next block and awesome restaurants, bars, cafes and bakeries within a couple of blocks.

The space
About the space:

3 near identical private rooms, roughly 150 sf. each: One would be yours.

1 shared bathroom.

Common space for eating and socializing.

The 3 private rooms have a large window facing east, giving the room a magical quality at and after dawn. Customize the amount of light in the room with blinds and blackout rollers to suit your preferences. You’ll have a full-size bed with either a winter duvet or summer light sheet, two pillows, two nightstands and lamps. You’ll have a small desk, a clothes hanger and always eventful views onto Bushwick Ave.

The bathroom you would share with the inhabitant(s) of the neighboring rooms so long hot showers and major grooming would not be so welcome when other guests are around. However, if no other guests are around you will be able to take a very hot shower for a long time. In the bathroom you’ll find shampoo, conditioner, body soap, extra toilet paper, q-tips, hair dryer, first aid kit, pain killers etc.

The common space is a very cozy space where you can do very basic cooking and eat and drink. It’s a lovely space to have coffee or tea in the morning but of course be mindful of your neighbors so smooth movements in the early and late hours please.

There is a laundry room on the 7th floor of the building and amazing views of the city on the roof deck which I absolutely recommend you check out.

During your stay
My apartment is in adjacent space that is connected to the airbnb portion you'll be staying in. I like to meet all my guests if I can, just because it makes hosting so much more enjoyable :) However, you probably won't see much of me but I'm always around if any issues arise or if you have some questions :)

listing_name: Room w/pvt bathroom on Central Park
description:
The beautiful guest bedroom w/private black marble bathroom is fully furnished in my renovated 3BR apartment in Manhattan on Upper West Side; across the street is Central Park! This classic turn-of-the century pre-war building is also close to subway, buses, museums & more! I'm a native NY'er, Airbnb host since 2012 & Super Host!

[ NOTE: Due to new NYC regulations for short term stays as of Sept 1, 2023, we are only accepting bookings with stays over 30 days. Please msg us if interested. ]

The space
Hello! I have a dedicated, beautiful guest bedroom with a private black marble bathroom, in my apartment in Manhattan on the Upper West Side. This classic New York building is turn-of-the century (pre-war / c. 1912), on the corner of Central Park West... across the street is Central Park! I'm a native NY'er, Airbnb host since 2012 & Super Host!

The apartment was fully renovated before I moved in (2004) and had it re-painted in 2020 and 2024. Please note, the apartment is a 4th floor walkup (no elevator).

The apartment is conveniently located near subway and buses... within walking distance to over a dozen museums, and you can get almost anywhere in Manhattan within 20-40 minutes, door-to door!

* Since the question comes up a lot, I am only renting this bedroom, not the entire apartment (I live in one of the bedrooms!). Also, please do not rent the room because of the piano... this is not a practice studio or a concert instrument. Guests may use the piano occasionally but it's not for hours of practice a day.

[ NOTE: Due to new NYC regulations for short term stays starting Sept 1, 2023, we can only accept bookings with stays over 30 days. We also had to move our listing, so reviews post pandemic don't show up here, unfortunately. Please msg us if interested or any questions. ]


THE ROOM:
This beautiful room is a dedicated guest bedroom, and is fully furnished with a private black marble full-bathroom (only you will use this bathroom!). There is beautiful brick wall, dark hardwood floors, and a wall-unit that lets you hang clothes, with drawers and shelves so you can fully unpack - you don't have to live out of a suitcase. There is a plush pillow-top Kings Down full-size mattress on a captains bed with 2 drawers that is available to put more of your things in. There is also a small wooden desk and chair. This is an interior bedroom within the apartment, and the windows face a light well (not Central Park). There is high-speed Wi-Fi throughout apartment, including this bedroom, and you are free to use it.

I will supply sheets and towels. The room will comfortably fit a couple. The bed has a cozy down comforter, and pillows. You are welcome to hang out in the large and comfortable living room during your stay. Guests are welcome to use the kitchen as much (or little) as you want. There is a shelf in the refrigerator for your food, as well as space in the cabinets to put groceries. I don't provide any food for guests, but there are grocery stores nearby. I have spices, sugar, etc which am happy to share.


THE APARTMENT
This is a large, furnished, 3 bedroom apartment with 2 marble bathrooms & kitchen (approx 1200 sq ft). It is a beautifully renovated pre-war building, and we are on the 4th floor (walk-up). There is hi speed wi-fi (mesh network) in the apartment. We live in the other two bedrooms so cannot rent the other rooms.


Most guests say this apartment looks like the quintessential New York City apartment, being right on Central Park with the brick walls in every room, fire escape, grand piano, and dark wood floors.


Since I am a composer and music producer the apartment is filled with musical things... photos and posters from my shows, musical instruments, and my studio setup. I also have a 6ft baby-grand Baldwin piano which guests can play during the day, when myself and my roommate are out of the apartment. I've had many wonderful musical guests stay, ranging from students auditioning at music conservatory to musicians performing at Carnegie Hall!


THE NEIGHBORHOOD
The neighborhood is residential area that is quiet and safe! The Police and Fire station is 2 blocks away. We are also within 2 blocks from a lot of stores including Whole Foods, a wine store, several pharmacies, various stores, banks, a bakery, several restaurants, and dry cleaner. 3 blocks away on Broadway are tons of restaurants, and many deliver.


THE LOCATION
We are located right on Central Park West on the Upper West Side of Manhattan - a very residential area. You can get almost anywhere in Manhattan within 20-40 minutes. Within walking distance of the apartment are more then a dozen museums including the Metropolitan Museum of Art, Guggenheim, Natural History Museum, Hayden Planetarium, Neue Gallery, Jewish Museum, and many more. Also within walking distance is the famous \Tom's Diner\"used in Seinfeld!


TRANSPORTATION
The 96th street B and C subway is a 2 minute walk from the building. Within 20 minutes (by subway) you can be in Times Square and the theater district for Broadway Shows. Within 20 to 40 min you can be almost anywhere in Manhattan! You can walk thru the park in about 15 or 20 minutes to the Metropolitan Museum of Art

description:
Fully furnished 1-bedroom ground floor apartment with a private back garden in a happening Brooklyn neighborhood of restaurants, bars & shopping. It's a typical small Brooklyn home from the 1860s! and was renovated with eco-attention and furnished with class and all the comforts.

The space
Really nice 1-bedroom floor through with a private back garden in a hip Brooklyn neighborhood. Our house is quiet and serene. The apartment will be empty for at least 3 days before your arrival. Thorough cleaning and disinfection of all surfaces is guaranteed. Your safety is our top concern.

Please note that we keep a shoe-free house. You should leave your outside shoes in the wood bench for that purpose outside of your front door. Please bring house shoes or slippers with you for use inside the apartment. Thanks for helping to keep the space super-clean!

Apartment has hardwood bamboo floors, a ceramic tile bathroom, granite counter tops, solid wood furniture. It was recently renovated and has new kitchen appliances: refrigerator, stove, dishwasher and washing machine (no dryer but a line in the backyard). There are big front and back windows, an all glass door to the back garden and a skylight in the entry hallway ie, pretty good light for a fully attached building. The apartment is fully furnished in high quality : a full sized double bed with a brand new mattress (March 2020), night tables and lamps, wood dresser & wood wardrobes, lovely 1940s original loveseat in the bedroom: gorgeous Amish dining table, original 1960s chairs and lots of cabinet space in the kitchen/dining area; a storage bench, futon couch, end tables and brass lamps, built-in wood cabinets including one made by my grandfather, flat screen tv and a coffee table in the living area. Also Bose speakers for plugging in your music.

There's plenty of space for your things: a big under-the-stairs closet fully empty, one bedroom wardrobe fully empty (the other has our stuff stored in it) and half of our bedroom dresser. The kitchen has all you need but also space for your food.

All kitchenware (pots, pans, dishes, glasses, everything you need to cook and eat well) and all linens (sheets, pillowcases, towels, washcloths, blankets) are included. These are good quality: no teflon, no polyester. There is a split system in-wall air conditioner and 3 big ceiling fans to keep you cool in the humid NYC summer There's steam heat which you control and plenty of good hot water and water pressure. All utilities, including some tv (local + blu-ray), landline phone and wifi are included.

The back garden has tomatoes and herbs and raspberries, azaleas, a fig tree, and grapes, etc. It needs TLC and it will reward you. listing_name: Dumbo Loft With A Beautiful View
description:
Waterfront loft apartment in Dumbo overlooking the skyline, Brooklyn Bridge, East River, and parks.

The space
WATERFRONT PARKSIDE DUMBO LOFT WITH STELLAR VIEWS

* Seeking multi-week guest for March 7 through April 3 or so. Some flexibility on exact dates. *

This is my 700 square foot loft apartment in Dumbo, Brooklyn, which has one of the best views in all of New York City. It is directly on the waterfront across the street from the park. (Yes, the view photos were actually taken from my window.)

This is my actual home, and I only rent it out when I'm traveling. It is completely private. There is no sharing of the space with anyone else.

I'm on an upper floor of a century-old brick-and-timber building. There are hardwood floors, giant windows, high ceilings and exposed brick.

It's a loft/studio layout with one bedroom alcove that has a king-sized bed. There is a living room with a variety of vintage seating opportunities, a working nook near the window, and a dining table that does dinner for eight.

Yes, there is wifi, an elevator, real A/C and heating, a kitchen designed for actual cooking, washer/dryer in building, and even soundproofed windows.

The view from the windows speaks for itself. It is like a moving painting, overlooking the East River, Financial District, the Brooklyn & Manhattan Bridges, a Victorian-era carousel, the South St Seaport and a giant park.

Dumbo is beautiful, quiet neighborhood, but there are restaurants, bars, shops, a fancy 24-hour grocery store and things to do within a few blocks.

The Brooklyn Bridge Park has recently been expanded and is now one of the most amazing recreation spaces in New York.

Dumbo is very convenient to Chinatown, the LES, Soho, Tribeca, East & West Village, Chelsea, Midtown and other North BK neighborhoods like Williamsburg, Fort Greene and Brooklyn Heights.

The F is very close and the A/C trains are also nearby. This is exactly one stop from Manhattan. Under ten minutes to Wall St or Chinatown, 15 minutes to downtown neighborhoods, and 30 minutes to Times Square.


MORE ABOUT THE BUILDING:

The building was built around 1900 by EW Bliss & Company for the manufacture of tools, presses, lathes, dies, and other metal equipment. One old photo of the building and an engraving are included in the photo set.

During World War II, most of the neighborhood's factories were adapted to suit military needs. Munitions were manufactured here, which led to the creation of the separated building in the center the block, where finished products were stored.

As manufacturing in NYC and America began its slow decline, the upper floors of the building got turned into lofts. People starting covertly living here in the early 80s, and eventually the building became the amalgam of live/work spaces, apartments and small businesses that it is today.


BEFORE YOU CONTACT ME:

Please read the Other Details and Rules sections. Tell me about yourself. Consider that you are asking me to rent my home to you while I am not present.

PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE:

This is not an Airbnb rental business, so I cannot respond in real-time. It sometimes takes a full day for me to reply to inquiries, and I almost always have follow up questions. I prefer for people to visit in person or send a friend to see the place before confirming.

PAPERS REQUIRED FOR ALL RENTERS:

My building requires you to provide a copy of your ID, home address, and employer information for their files, as well as a simple rental agreement. The safety of our building, my home, and our neighbors is important to us.

Guest access
The entire apartment.

Other things to note
Here are some more details about the building and the apartment.

I know this is a lot– but it is my actual home and neighbors, not a commercial Airbnb business, and I want everyone to have reasonable expectations and enjoy.

As these are long-term bookings and you will be living here, I strongly prefer renters that can visit the apartment before confirming a stay, or send a friend to do so.

Altogether, this is a wonderful building, apartment and neighborhood. I absolutely love living here, cannot imagine living anywhere else, and get compliments about my home all of the time. But it’s not for everyone.

I have been subletting this apartment on Airbnb for over a decade, and these are the reminders I've come up with to make sure everyone will be satisfied.

This is a live/work loft building. It is not a luxury condominium loft building, or a normal apartment building. There is no doorman. The common areas feel like a warehouse, not a hotel or brownstone. People expecting a luxury, hotel, new construction, or concierge experience should look elsewhere.

I do keep the place tidy, but it is not sparkling clean like an art gallery, hotel room, or a new construction building. All of the furniture has a “lived in” quality.

The carpentry in my unit has been done by tenants over the last 20 years, and is a little funny and DIY. There are some places where the walls could use patching or repainting, and various odds and ends.

There is a nice and recently-renovated lobby, elevator, laundry room, and HVAC.

The kitchen has a full-size induction range with oven, and full fridge/freezer, but does not have a dishwasher.

The walls between units and the floors and ceilings are not soundproof. It is normal to hear neighbors from time to time during the day and sometimes at night. Some of my neighbors have small children.

The apartment itself must be quiet after 10pm. It cannot be used for parties or late night gatherings. Do not invite anyone over that you would not trust in your own home. You cannot play loud music inside at any time.

There is no smoking anywhere inside the building.

As per Airbnb’s rules, the rental is for the person or people on the Airbnb booking, only. You cannot add a roommate, family member, etc. You cannot host your friends from out-of-town, or allow others to use the apartment while you are not present. No pets. No one is ever allowed to sleep on the living room furniture.

The cleaning fee included in the rental is not an ongoing maid service-- it’s for a full day of surface cleaning, dusting, etc. before you arrive, and after you leave.

You should leave the apartment in the condition it was found in, including basic cleaning every week. The bathroom surfaces need to be scrubbed and disinfected every week. If you really do not want to clean, please let me know and we’ll schedule additional cleaning sessions at additional expense. (Unfortunately, I have had guests who have stayed 4+ weeks and not picked up a sponge once.)

If anything is damaged, broken, dented, or needs repair or replacement during your stay, you will be responsible for it.

Finally, I must make an official sublease agreement with all guests, which includes a legal name, home address and work address, along with a copy of a government-issued photo ID. These are my landlord’s rules, so I have to go through the paperwork process.

I want to make sure all of my guests have the right expectations and will enjoy staying here.

Please let me know if you have any questions or want to speak or visit before booking.

listing_name: Williamsburg Penthouse Hideaway
description:
The north bedroom in my 3-bed penthouse apartment. The third bedroom is for friends from out of town. Penthouse because it’s the entire top floor, not because there's a helipad and a pool. :) This is Brooklyn. But I think you’ll like it for the reasons I do: five trains within a 5-min walk, live music everywhere, late-night restaurants, McCarren park nearby and the atmosphere of a real neighborhood. After seven years (five as a host), I still love it. You will too!

The space
DESCRIPTION:

DIY IS YOUR FRIEND
- You'll notice this as soon as you come into the apartment. James and I loved building things and putting the apartment together with our own touches. The living room cocktail table we brought from central Brooklyn on the subway and spent four days sanding, cleaning, painting and constructing it into a table. You'll see touches like this all over the apartment.

BOUJI TO BUSTED
- Have drinks on the roof of the Wythe Hotel for $14 and look out over all of Williamburg or spend $5 and get a PBR and a shot at Union Cafe with a taco in their back garden and listen to some live music. This neighborhood caters to the whole spectrum and you can eat til 2 am and drink til 4 am.

LOWER MANHATTAN IS 1 STOP AWAY
- 5 Train lines within a 5 minute walk of the apartment, the J, M, Z and G, L so getting into Manhattan is easy and the trains run 24 hours a day.

ENJOY YOUR PRIVACY
- If you want to have a chat catch me when I'm having a cocktail on the weekends and getting ready to go out and we'll have a laugh, but other than that you have privacy and I let you do your thing while I recharge during the week in my space doing mine.
- The locks for the rooms are privacy locks. The only ones available by law in New York City.

8 YEARS OF AIRBNB HOSTING - 2000+ GUESTS
- Yep. That's right. Been doing this for 8 years and have had over 7000 guests so it’s a pretty well oiled machine.

Hope to meet you soon! If you have any questions, ask away!

Guest access
- Bathroom
(Clean your hair out of the shower though. Yikes! I'm bald and this gets nasty to see. Thanks!)

- Kitchen
(Cook away or store your takeaway in the fridge. But do your dishes. Only I get to be lazy on occasion and don't...joke. Not really. I mean I'm human and sometimes you just wanna get to the Haagen Dasz.)

- Living Room
(Try to be respectful if it's late.)

- Your Room

During your stay
I'm a writer and easy-going but I'm in my head most of the time and enjoy it. If you're staying you'll get full use of the apartment.

Other things to note
- Street parking is available. But you have to move your car Tuesday's through Friday's 9:00am-10:30am for street cleaning and it alternates sides of the street.

When you confirm the room the airbnb guide we completed has our favorite restaurants nearby, fun places we like to go, music and bars that we've done plenty of personal research to find. Guests that have checked out the restaurants in particular have really been pleased.

We've had a handful of people who are new to being guests through Airbnb and I think its important to know several things. The heat is via radiators since the building is traditional brick three story so can be uneven, so we've added a safe electrical heater in the room and guests have said its more than adequate to get the room toasty hot. Also, smoking is permitted on the fire escape but not in the apartment.

LGBT friendly!

EARLY CHECK-IN & BAG DROP/LUGGAGE STORAGE AFTER CHECK OUT/LATE ARRIVAL:
We offer these optional services at an additional cost. The terms and details are outlined in the welcome message after you book.

INTERNATIONAL TRAVELERS: If you are interested in the room you can expect a response very quickly between 10:00am-7:00pm NYC time, a few people were sad they booked with others before they heard from me but it was 4am my time when it came in and I'm not checking my email til about 10 am daily and then as often in the evening. Just to let you know.

PROFESSIONAL USAGE / NON-STANDARD
- Only permitted with my prior agreed upon permission.

VISITORS/ALTERNATE OCCUPANTS
- No visitors for any duration are allowed and only the person registered under the profile and their sole guest (if booking with one) are allowed inside the apartment.

KEY RETURN & KEYFOB REPLACEMENT
- The electronic key fobs given at checkin are expensive to replace. If you lose one or it's damaged you'll be required to pay $40 per fob (there are two) and the custom key is $35.
- Charges of $15 per half hour are added for holding the keys after 11am or in the case of when the keys are available at a kiosk, if they are not returned by 11am properly for the next guests to pickup.
